acceptanceCriteria: For a fixture handler whose guard performs a token exchange, the query lists the issuer and identity-endpoint keys and marks the token-exchange call as outbound.
A pre-run check against a profile with those keys empty reports them by name only and does not schedule the batch.
A handler whose outbound guard precedes a cheap validation guard is flagged; reordered, it is not.
Keys or calls that cannot be resolved statically are reported as unknown, not absent.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1200. (1) For a route or handler, list the environment and config keys read on its request path, including guards and the service clients they call, and mark which make outbound network calls. (2) Pre-run check: given a target environment profile, report unset or empty keys by name only (never value) before a batch is scheduled; fail closed or warn. (3) Guard-order analysis: flag handlers where a guard making an outbound call runs before cheaper validation guards, so tests aimed at later behaviour implicitly need a stand-in. Related, distinct: V1-1940 (#1199 test-process env contract), V1-1931 (#1192 unstubbed outbound integrations).
title: GH #1200: request-path environment/config keys, outbound calls and guard order before a test batch runs
